description: Implementation of an event loop using epoll, managing file descriptors and their event handlers, including registration, removal, and event processing.

classes.name: EventLoopImpl
classes.description: A class implementing an event loop based on epoll, handling registration, deregistration, and event dispatching for file descriptors.

methods.name: EventLoopImpl::EventLoopImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the epoll instance and setting the timeout.

methods.name: EventLoopImpl::~EventLoopImpl
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up file descriptors and closing the epoll instance.

methods.name: EventLoopImpl::register_handlers
methods.description: Registers file descriptor handlers for specific events.

methods.name: EventLoopImpl::remove_handlers
methods.description: Removes file descriptor handlers from the event loop.

methods.description: Sets a human-readable name for a file descriptor handler.
